newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SPANISH LEAGUE MATCHES THIS WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPANISH LEAGUE MATCHES THIS WEEKEND.

text.p: Matches scheduled for this weekend in the Spanish championship (league standings in parentheses, all kick off times gmt)
Playing Saturday:
Real Madrid (1) v Atletico Madrid (5) kick-off 1830
A point in the Madrid derby game will be enough to give Real their 27th Spanish title, while Atletico will be thirsting for revenge after January's humiliating 4-1 defeat.
Playing Sunday:
Extremadura (19) v Celta Vigo (16) 1700

One of a series of crunch matches this weekend, and a game Extremadura must win to have any chance of avoiding the drop straight back down to the second divsion. Striker Carlos Dure is back from injury for the home side.
Valladolid (7) v Hercules (20) 1700
A win will guarantee unfancied Valladolid a UEFA Cup place after a campaign which has seen Vicente Cantatore elected the best coach in Spain. Hercules are already condemned to relegation.
Sporting Gijon (17) v Rayo Vallecano (18) 1700
A desperate struggle in which defeat could leave Rayo condemned to a relegation play-off. Sporting bring back midfielders Tomas Hervas, Sergio and David Cano.
Valencia (9) v Oviedo (15) 1700

Valencia confirmed coach Jorge Valdano in his post earlier in the week, but there is dressing-room unease at the club ahead of the game with Oviedo, who are still struggling to avoid a place in the relegation play-off match.
Sevilla (21) v Espanyol (14) 1700

Sevilla are in turmoil after the news that over half the first team squad will have to leave the club as a cost-cutting measure before dropping into the second division. Espanyol could use the points to avoid last-match relegation worries.
Logrones (22) v Racing Santander (12) 1700
Racing still, theoretically, have a chance of being relegated and will hope for a result against Logrones, who are already condemned to the second division.
Compostela (11) v Real Sociedad (8) 1700

Real need to win to keep their outside UEFA Cup hopes alive, but could be left without regular strikers because of an injury crisis. Compostela still don't know the whereabouts of troublesome Bulgarian striker Lyuboslav Penev.
Tenerife (10) v Zaragoza (13) 1700

Zaragoza are out of trouble after a difficult season, while Tenerife coach Jupp Heynckes seems to have his mind focused on what could be his new job -- at Real Madrid. Zaragoza keeper Otto Konrad is doubtful for the match with knee trouble.
Barcelona (2) v Real Betis (4) 1730

An appetizer for June 28's Spanish Cup final, the game will mean nothing unless Real Madrid let Barcelona back into the title race by losing on Saturday. Barcelona are without striker Ronaldo and injured defender Miguel Angel Nadal.
Playing Monday:
Athletic Bilbao (6) v Deportivo Coruna (3) 1930

Deportivo ensured a UEFA Cup place long ago, while Athletic will only have something to play for if rivals Real Sociedad win on Sunday. The game will see the farewell of veteran Athletic defender Genar Andrinua.
